title: arthromeris himalayensis f. niphoboloides
intro: Arthromeris himalayensis f. niphoboloides, commonly known as Himalayan Arthromeris, is a species of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan Arthromeris include wound healing, anti-cancer activities, and cardiovascular protective effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully elucidate the bioactive constituents and therapeutic potential of this plant.
